milestones.label: Applications open
milestones.note: The course catalogue for the year is published the same day.

milestones.label: Ordinary application deadline
milestones.note: Last day to apply or to add further choices. Completed education must be documented the same day.

milestones.label: Documentation deadline for education finished this spring
milestones.note: Five days before IB results are published. Samordna opptak's instruction for an IB student graduating this year: you will not be able to upload the diploma in time, so give the institutions electronic access through the IB's Request for Results Service, filled in with your coordinator.

milestones.label: Last day to change the order of your choices
milestones.note: An offer on a higher choice removes every lower one permanently, with no wait-list. The order on this date is the order that decides your year.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After the Norwegian documentation deadline. The institutions read your results through the IB's Request for Results Service, which you arrange with your coordinator in advance.

notes: Every date is carried from the published 2026 calendar and marked provisional; re-checked 24 September 2026, when the page still said it covered the 2026 intake.
